---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or architectural enhancement for the platform
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. *I want doctors to see which area of the skin lesion influenced the prediction.*

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g. *Add Grad-CAM visual explainability heatmap overlay on the input image*).

**Component / Area Affected**
- [ ] Machine Learning Pipeline (New CNN architecture, Test-time Augmentation)
- [ ] Backend API (New REST endpoints, Database optimizations)
- [ ] Frontend UI (Visualizations, Dashboard charts, Camera integration)
- [ ] DevOps & Deployment (CI/CD workflows, Docker optimizations)

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or research papers related to the feature request here.
